theme:ai-power.value: 2026-11-05 The AI power trade sold off hard on Nov 4 after Democrats won Congress and Texas elected a governor who campaigned on a pause for new data centers. Vistra fell 13.83%, Vertiv 12.89%, Eaton 9.86%, GE Vernova 9.30% and Constellation 6.71% (Massive). Goldman estimates state moratoriums could put about 45% of planned US data center capacity at risk; Wells Fargo says Texas holds about 27% of it (Yahoo, CNBC).
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-11-04 After Democrats won both chambers, the Invesco Solar ETF (TAN) rose more than 8% before the open on Nov 4 on hopes for renewed clean energy tax credits (Yahoo). On Nov 3 GEV rose 6.49% to 918.20 and ENPH 8.92% to 30.42 (Massive). A Caterpillar director bought about $620,000 at $620.39 on Nov 2, filed Nov 3 (dashboard).

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-30 North American robot orders rose 25% in Q3 2026, and collaborative robots reached 1,831 units worth $63.8 million, up about 56% in units from a year earlier (Metrology News, Oct 30).
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-29 ARK bought Teradyne in ARKK, ARKQ and ARKX on Oct 28, about 0.25% of each fund (ARK email). AGCO is running Agility Robotics humanoids at its Hesston, Kansas plant, and Schaeffler has humanoids building actuator parts for other humanoids in China (engineering.com, Oct 28).

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-11-05 China's one year pause of its October 2025 rare earth export rules ends Nov 10, and no extension notice was found as of Nov 4 to 5 (Mining.com, Motley Fool). MP Materials fell 5.08% to 35.91 on Nov 4 (Massive), near a 16 month low, and reports Q3 after today's close.
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-30 Rio Tinto said it has begun restarting underground operations at its Oyu Tolgoi copper mine in Mongolia after a seismic event halted mining (Reuters, Oct 30).

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-11-05 Defense stocks fell on Nov 4 on fears a Democratic Congress trims the Pentagon budget: Lockheed fell 6.88%, L3Harris 6.46%, Northrop 4.53% and RTX 2.64% (Massive). Jefferies expects the 2027 budget nearer the House's roughly $1.15 trillion than the $1.5 trillion request, and TD Cowen called Golden Dome and Golden Fleet most at risk and nuclear modernization least at risk (Reuters via US News).
theme:defense-reshoring.was: 2026-11-04 Democrats won control of the House and Senate on Nov 3 (CBS, CNN), so a Democratic Congress will set defense budgets and oversight from January while the President keeps his veto. Defense names lagged before the open on Nov 4 (CNBC). Two Boeing directors bought about $1.5 million of stock near $172 on Oct 30, filed Nov 3 (dashboard).

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-11-05 ARK bought SpaceX (SPCX) in three funds on Nov 4 (about 348,000 shares across ARKK, ARKQ and ARKW, ARK email) while the stock fell 3.81% to 135.92 with the AI and Musk names (Massive, CNBC).
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-29 Fortinet fell 25.7% premarket on Oct 29 after its Q3: results beat, but product growth of 37% missed the roughly 50% the market wanted and it cut its service revenue guide to $5.15 billion to $5.17 billion; BofA downgraded it to Neutral with a $140 target, and an unconfirmed breach report added pressure (Investing.com). Palo Alto, Zscaler and CrowdStrike fell in sympathy.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-11-05 Medtech, hospitals and Medicaid insurers rallied on Nov 4 on bets a Democratic Congress delays Medicaid cuts: Intuitive Surgical rose 9.38%, Stryker 9.37%, HCA 10.34%, Medtronic 6.15%, Dexcom 6.64% and Insulet 6.56% (Massive; Investrade). Zoetis reported Q3 this morning: revenue $2.39 billion, down 1%, adjusted EPS $1.75 against $1.51 expected by Zacks, and it raised full year adjusted EPS guidance to $6.25 to $6.35 (AP).
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-11-04 Insulet's Q3 revenue was $842.0 million, up 19.2% and above its own guidance range; international Omnipod grew 31.7% and US Omnipod 14.7%; adjusted EPS rose 59.9% to $1.99 and adjusted operating margin rose 4.9 points to 22.0% (Insulet, Nov 4).

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-11-05 The election hit the suppliers of the AI build, not the buyers. On Nov 4 CoreWeave fell 9.90%, Nebius 6.67%, Nvidia 3.17% and Lumentum 7.85%, while Microsoft rose 6.68% and Amazon 6.12% (Massive). After the close Qualcomm guided below estimates and fell about 9% premarket, while Coherent beat with data center and communications revenue up 79% to $1.95 billion and guided above estimates (CNBC, MoneyCheck). Korea's KOSPI fell 5.28% on Nov 5 with SK hynix down 9.46% (Korea Exchange via FN News).
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-11-04 AMD guided Q4 revenue to about $17 billion, plus or minus 3%, against about $16.2 to $16.3 billion expected, after Q3 revenue of $13.38 billion, up 45%; it sees data center sales up about 50% from Q3 (Nov 3). The FT and Reuters report Oracle cancelled a five year, roughly $7 billion lease of about 100,000 AI chips to Tencent in Southeast Asia after US officials raised concerns (Nov 4).

theme:glp1-obesity.value: 2026-11-05 Novo Nordisk's Q3 beat on its Wegovy pill: pill sales were DKK 5.39 billion against DKK 4.62 billion expected, and it raised 2026 sales guidance to minus 2% to plus 2% at constant currency. Injectable Wegovy fell 13%, and US list prices for Wegovy and Ozempic drop to $675 a month from Jan 1, 2027 (CNBC, Nov 4). NVO closed up 4.95% at 42.18 (Massive).
theme:glp1-obesity.was: 2026-10-31 Lilly closed at a record 1,417.54 on Oct 30, up 11.31% for the week after its Q3 beat and raise (Massive). ARK sold 17,626 LLY shares in ARKK the same day, about 0.39% of the fund (ARK email).

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-11-05 Remitly reported Q3 on Nov 4: revenue $509.8 million, up 22%; send volume $24.4 billion, up 25%; 10.3 million active customers; net income $67.6 million; and a full year revenue outlook of $1.989 to $1.991 billion. The buyback authorization rose from $200 million to $500 million (SEC 8-K, TipRanks). Affirm reports after today's close, with a 2pm Pacific call.
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-31 Analysts blame North Korea's TraderTraitor unit for the $6.3 billion Binance hack, most of which left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes; Binance reserved over $6.3 billion to cover losses and plans a proof of reserves report by Monday (BBC). COIN fell 12.72% for the week to 143.54, HOOD 10.6% to 84.99 and CRCL 15.6% to 72.54 (Massive), while ARK bought all three on Oct 30 (ARK email).

industry:agriculture-food.value: 2026-10-29 Rechecked on the daily rotation. AGCO's Q3 (Oct 29) sales fell 8.6% to $2.26 billion, with Latin America down 19.1% and Brazil tractor retail sales down 17% for nine months; it kept its 2026 outlook and targets $2 billion of PTx retrofit sales by 2029 from about $1 billion this year. About 29% of global urea trade normally passes Hormuz (S&P Global), which keeps the cost case for nitrogen-fixing biologicals alive. No stage moves: the PRRS pig still waits on Mexico and Japan, and Corteva reports Nov 11.
industry:agriculture-food.was: 2026-10-17 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Deere announced next generation perception autonomy kits in early October for tractors and tillage, orchard sprayers, and landscape and construction machines, and AGCO's Oct 6 Tech Day showed PTx retrofit autonomy for mixed fleets. Corteva set its first crop protection only report for Nov 11 after the close. Perfect Day now targets first commercial whey deliveries from India in Q1 2027. No stage moves: these are product launches, not new revenue.

industry:communications.value: 2026-11-02 Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum for $115 billion in stock, combining Marvell's electrical chips with Lumentum's lasers and optics for AI data centers. Marvell says the deal lifts its addressable market to $550 billion (company release via CNBC, Nov 2). It is the largest bet yet that optical links become the chokepoint inside AI clusters.
industry:communications.was: 2026-10-24 On Oct 23 reports said SpaceX is seeking cell tower sites for a mobile carrier service, building on its roughly $8 billion purchase of 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management earlier in October. Crown Castle rose about 9% to 85.97 and American Tower about 4% to 188.97, while AT&T fell 8.0% to 20.93 on 2.4 times normal volume and T-Mobile 7.7% to 146.54 (Motley Fool midday, Oct 23; dashboard and Yahoo Finance closes).

industry:consumer.value: 2026-10-30 Rotation recheck. EssilorLuxottica's Q3 wearables revenue was 486 million euros, up 20% but a sharp slowdown in smart glasses growth (Reuters, Oct 20). Dexcom's Q3 revenue rose 11% to $1.3445 billion and it raised its 2026 guide to $5.20 billion to $5.25 billion (Oct 29). The FDA panel on SYD-101 meets Oct 30 with FDA doubts on the data (Pink Sheet). Oura still has no IPO date. No stage moves.
industry:consumer.was: 2026-10-18 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Dexcom set Q3 results for Oct 29 after the close and Hims for Nov 9; Abbott reports Oct 21. The FDA panel on Sydnexis's SYD-101 myopia drop is still set for Oct 30, and Oura has not set a new IPO date since postponing on Sep 29. No stage moves: these are dates, not new revenue or approvals.

industry:defense-security.value: 2026-10-31 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Missile defense production money keeps growing on multiyear terms: L3Harris got seven year contracts of $6.3 billion for THAAD propulsion and $4.7 billion for PAC-3 MSE propulsion, holds a record $53.2 billion backlog and opened a new solid rocket motor plant in Arkansas; it also booked more than $500 million of VAMPIRE counter drone orders (Defence Industry Europe, Oct 30). The US approved a $2.1 billion Patriot sale to Ukraine (Reuters, Oct 30). No stage moves: this is production money for fielded interceptors, while hypersonics and space based defense still wait on tests and the full year budget.
industry:defense-security.was: 2026-10-19 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Drone Dominance Gauntlet II orders have started (Neros 14,000 drones for over $100 million, Swarm Defense 4,000 for at least $25 million), the Army now expects its first LOCUST X3 laser by Q4 FY2027 and combat use by early 2028, and the Senate leader signaled no new Golden Dome reconciliation money before the midterms. No stage moves: orders are small next to the 60,000 drone plan.

industry:energy.value: 2026-11-01 Rotation check. Oracle's Project Jupiter cleared a step: on Oct 26 a New Mexico hearing officer refused to dismiss its air permit application, after an Oct 14 redesign that cuts emissions about 35% and uses 1,600 MW of Bloom fuel cells instead of the 2,462 MW allocated (Santa Fe New Mexican). The state decision is due Nov 23 but may slip to Dec 18, with a public hearing from Dec 7. Dates set: NuScale Nov 5, Oklo Nov 6 and Fervo Nov 9 report Q3; the TAE and Trump Media vote is listed for Dec 14. No stage moves.
industry:energy.was: 2026-10-23 Bloom Energy's Q3 (Oct 22) showed behind the meter power is selling: product revenue crossed $1 billion for the first time ($1.07 billion, up 179%), total revenue rose 138% to $1.24 billion, and 2026 revenue guidance rose to $4.4 to $4.6 billion. The catch is cash: the quarter used $181 million of free cash flow as inventory and receivables grew.

industry:financials.value: 2026-11-04 Daily rotation recheck. Upstart's Q3 originations rose 44% to $4.1 billion but slipped from Q2's $4.2 billion, and the CEO said the economy weighs on the near term outlook, though net income was $36.6 million (SEC 8-K, Nov 3). NiCE's Q3 AI recurring revenue grew 46% to $392 million while total revenue grew 8.0%, and it raised full year EPS guidance (Nov 4). DTCC's October tokenization launch is still not confirmed.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-27 SoFi launched SOFIE on Oct 22, which it calls the first national bank issued tokenized deposit for consumers: each token is $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, FDIC insured, paying 4.40% APY, and can be converted 1:1 into its SoFiUSD stablecoin, which ends the yield and the insurance (SoFi, The Block). Rollout to its crypto customers finishes in November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-11-05 Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill sold DKK 5.39 billion in Q3, above the DKK 4.62 billion forecast, and lifted combined US Wegovy sales 21% even as the injection fell 13%. Novo raised its 2026 sales guide and cuts US list prices for Wegovy and Ozempic to $675 a month from Jan 1, 2027 (CNBC, Nov 4).
industry:healthcare.was: 2026-10-29 Lilly's Q3 revenue rose 39% to $24.4 billion, driven by Mounjaro and Zepbound, and it raised 2026 revenue guidance to $91 billion to $92 billion from $85 billion to $87 billion, its third raise this year (company release, Quartz). West Pharmaceutical, which supplies pen and vial components, also beat and raised.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-11-03 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Symbotic has not set its fiscal Q4 date (a third party site lists Nov 23, unconfirmed); it guided Q4 revenue to $760 to $780 million. Stratasys has not announced the close of its $42.5 million Markforged purchase, and PTC has not set the shareholder vote on Schneider's $205 a share cash offer. No stage changes: none of the four innovations has new cost, approval or revenue data since Oct 26.
industry:industrials.was: 2026-10-26 Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that early Optimus production has started on a Fremont line built for about 1 million robots a year, that reaching about 20,000 a week will take at least a year, and that it plans to sell to outside companies around the end of 2027, with its AI5 chip in Optimus around April 2027. Stage stays pilot: output is for internal use and there are no outside orders yet.

industry:materials.value: 2026-11-05 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Navitas Q3 2026 revenue was $14.0 million, up 38% from a year earlier and above guidance, with high power revenue up more than 50% from Q2; it guides Q4 to $16.0 million (SEC filings). Still tiny, so the stage stays early adoption.
industry:materials.was: 2026-10-27 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Hexcel reported Q3 on Oct 21: sales about $496 million, up 8.8%, adjusted EPS $0.50 against $0.37, commercial aerospace up about 21% and defense and space down about 9%. It kept 2026 guidance, but shares fell about 11% to 12% as sales missed the roughly $502 million forecast (SEC filing, Investing.com).

industry:space.value: 2026-10-28 Rechecked on the daily rotation. SpaceX's Q3 2026 report (Oct 20) showed revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161%, and net income of $4.4 billion, and called Flight 14 its first revenue generating Starship mission; but its rocket business lost $7 million in the quarter and $1.21 billion in nine months, so Starlink and AI carry the profit. SpaceX says Flight 15 will try to catch both the booster and the ship; no date is confirmed. Rocket Lab pushed Neutron's first launch to 2027 on Oct 14 over tank defects (Reuters). RKLB closed up 8.34% at 58.31 on Oct 27 (Massive).
industry:space.was: 2026-10-15 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 14 (Sep 28) was the first to reach orbit and deployed all 26 Starlink V3 satellites, though a vacuum engine failed and the stay in orbit was cut short; Flight 15 is penciled for no earlier than Oct 19 but not confirmed. SpaceX was reported Oct 6 to 7 to be seeking about $40 billion of debt to buy Nvidia chips. Planet Labs stock is down about 66% from its May peak even with record revenue, as money rotates to SpaceX and rates rise.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-29 Marvell is in advanced talks to buy Lumentum, a maker of lasers for data center optics, with a deal possibly announced next week (Reuters, Oct 28). If it closes, a major chip designer would own a key laser supplier for optical links, including co-packaged optics. MRVL fell over 11% and LITE rose over 6% premarket Oct 29 (TradingKey). The stage does not change: this is a deal, not new revenue.
industry:technology.was: 2026-10-22 Meta narrowed 2026 capex to $135 to $145 billion but gave no 2027 number and had about negative $2.1 billion of free cash flow in Q3 (Oct 21). The inference build is still growing, but the biggest buyer now spends more than it earns, so 2027 budgets are the test.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-11-02 Rechecked on the daily rotation. Aurora's Q3 letter (Oct 28) moved its 200 driverless truck goal from the end of 2026 to the end of February 2027 and set a new goal of more than 1,000 trucks by the end of 2027. Q3 revenue was $3 million, the net loss $234 million, and it had about $1.03 billion of cash and short term investments with about $250 million of cash use expected in Q4. It has passed 500,000 commercial driverless miles. No paying air taxi passenger, no final FAA drone rule and no Tesla Dallas launch were confirmed as of Nov 2.
industry:transportation.was: 2026-10-23 Rechecked on the daily rotation. On its Oct 21 call Tesla said its Austin Cybercab fleet grew about 10 times since the early September launch, neared 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles, and should reach Dallas next month, with first customer Cybercab deliveries targeted by end of 2026. It also cut 2026 capex to about $20 billion. The FAA drone rule (Part 108) is still at White House review past its Oct 8 window, and neither Joby nor Archer has confirmed a paying passenger.

country:argentina.value: 2026-10-30 The Merval fell 1% to 94,530 on Oct 29, a fourth straight loss, while dollar bonds rebounded and country risk eased under 750 points (Ambito). In New York YPF fell 3.10% to 47.81 and ARGT 1.03% to 81.48 (Massive).
country:argentina.was: 2026-10-23 Argentina's country risk rose to 709 points on Oct 22 and the official dollar sold at a nominal record 1,550 pesos at Banco Nacion (wholesale 1,528), while the Merval fell 1.5% to 97,993 as the tech sell off hit ADRs (Rio Times).

country:brazil.value: 2026-11-05 Copom held the Selic at 13.75% on Nov 4, unanimously, and ended the cuts that began in March. 72 of 105 institutions expected the hold and 33 a cut to 13.50%, so part of the market was surprised. The statement cited the dollar, El Nino and inflation expectations above target and gave no guidance for December (Poder360, Sou Brasilia, Revista Oeste).
country:brazil.was: 2026-11-01 Brazil's stock market is shut Monday Nov 2 for All Souls' Day, so Brazilian shares cannot react at home to the weekend until Tuesday, though EWZ and the ADRs trade in New York (Rio Times, Nov 1). Forecasts for Wednesday's Copom split: the central bank's Focus survey median still points to a 0.25 point cut to 13.50%, while Polymarket now gives 81.2% to a hold at 13.75%, up from 78.4% (Rio Times). It is still not known whether the government will publish a spending plan before the meeting.

country:china.value: 2026-11-05 Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose about 3.67% on Nov 5 and the Hang Seng Tech index about 5.55%, its best day since February 2025, as money rotated out of AI hardware into cheaper Chinese internet names; Alibaba rose more than 8% and Tencent more than 7% (Bloomberg, BigGo Finance). Southbound funds were net sellers of more than HK$21.3 billion. FXI rose 4.22% to 34.59 on Nov 4 (Massive).
country:china.was: 2026-11-04 Oracle cancelled a roughly $7 billion, five year lease of about 100,000 AI chips to Tencent in Southeast Asian data centers after US officials raised concerns, the FT and Reuters report (Nov 4). Guangdong officials had also urged Tencent to back Chinese made chips.

country:europe.value: 2026-11-05 The Bank of England raised Bank Rate to 4.00% from 3.75% on Nov 5 in an 8 to 1 vote, its first hike in more than three years; Catherine Mann voted for 4.25%. The Bank tied the move to Middle East energy costs feeding into other prices. Next decision Dec 17 (Bank of England, FXStreet).
country:europe.was: 2026-10-30 The ECB held at 2.5% on Oct 29 and said a hike was debated; markets price about a 67% chance of a December hike. Lagarde will step down Feb 7, 2027. France's Q3 GDP fell 0.1%, and December Dutch gas rose to 101.63 euros on Oct 30, the highest since late 2022 (CNBC).

country:gulf.value: 2026-11-05 Brent fell 9.73% to settle at $93.52 on Nov 4, the lowest since Aug 31, on bets of a US and Iran deal (FinanceFeeds). One report says the US approved a Qatar draft memorandum; Iran called the US reply 'not convincing' and says Hormuz stays shut until its conditions are met (HNGN, Korea Herald). USO fell 8.07% and XLE 4.74% (Massive).
country:gulf.was: 2026-11-04 Asked whether he would strike Iran after the midterms, Trump said 'No', adding 'We're locked and loaded if we need to go, but there may be no reason for it' (Bloomberg, Ynet). Reports had said strike plans were ready from as early as Nov 4 (CBS). Qatar says both sides are reviewing its proposal; Iran called the US reply 'not convincing'. Brent fell 1.44% to $102.11 by 11:55 GMT Nov 4 (Dow Jones).

country:india.value: 2026-10-30 The Nifty rose 0.51% to 23,053.10 and the Sensex 0.42% to 74,459.53 on Oct 30, led by IT and pharma, while other Asian markets fell; Infosys rose 2.70% (Business Line, ET Now). Reserves fell a seventh straight week (Reuters).
country:india.was: 2026-10-29 The Sensex rose 905.01 points to 74,151.04 and the Nifty 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Oct 29 after the Fed held, led by banks and consumer stocks (Deccan Herald); the rupee closed at 95.25 per dollar (Economic Times). Brent easing toward $113 helps an oil importer.

country:japan.value: 2026-11-05 Toyota's Tokyo shares rose about 16.7% on Nov 5 after July to September operating profit rose 34% to about 1.13 trillion yen and it raised its full year operating profit forecast to 3.9 trillion yen from 3.4 trillion, helped by a weak yen and hybrids. China sales fell 12%. The Nikkei fell about 2.15%, led by chip names like Advantest (TipRanks, Investing.com).
country:japan.was: 2026-11-02 Kioxia fell about 14% after warning that flash memory price gains are stalling: average NAND selling prices rose in the mid 20% range in July to September, against 70% the quarter before, and its quarterly profit guide of 2 trillion yen was below the 2.35 trillion analysts expected (CNBC, Nov 2).
